description: Curated query corpus for dashboard regression testing. Each entry is a set of query params sent to /api/articles, plus assertions. Add a new case by appending to the queries array — no code change required.

queries.description: Chronological feed availability. Ingest volume is monitored separately.
Recall keyword in titles — key signal for FDA supply chain use case. Slow because ILIKE full-scans GAL (no text index yet).
Supply chain sanity floor. ILIKE on 4 GAL text columns is a full scan; larger time windows hit the per-connection memory limit and 503. Needs an FTS index or a materialized candidate table to scale.
Narrower text-search regression. Tracks real current performance — failures here mean text-search has gotten worse since the split.
Supply Chain Alerts live availability. Volume is monitored separately.
Regression: impossible query must return empty, not crash.
Default Importance sort — window's ranked events (deduped), so a bounded but non-trivial set.
Importance sort on a pill — same ranked set the AI briefing summarizes.
Regression: the classic reverse-chronological feed must still work under order=date.
